description: Dependency-update policy for @groundfloor/lore. Primary remote is Bitbucket Cloud (codementeam/groundfloor-lore) — Renovate reaches it via the Mend/Renovate app for Bitbucket Cloud (Renovate does not use GitHub-only Dependabot config, and none is present in this repo). The same file also governs the GitHub mirror (rafidowla/groundfloor-lore) if/when Renovate is installed there too, since Renovate reads this config from whichever remote it runs against.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly lockfile-only refresh (no manifest range changes) to pick up transitive-dependency fixes between explicit version bumps.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major (minor/patch) updates into a single PR per run instead of one PR per package.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security-driven updates bypass scheduling entirely and open immediately, independent of the weekly lockfile-maintenance and grouped minor/patch cadence above.
